units.source_text: 父親回東京時，我每天早上都匆匆地趕往學校，

en.t: When my father returned to Tokyo, every morning I would hurry off to school,

units.source_text: 但實際上有時是去了本鄉千馱木町的油畫家安田新太郎的繪畫教室，連續三四個小時練習素描。

en.t: but in fact there were times when I went instead to the painting class of the oil painter Shintaro Yasuda in Hongo-Sendagi-cho and practiced sketching for three or four hours straight.

units.source_text: 從高中宿舍出來後，即使到學校坐在教室上課，也感覺自己就是一位身份特別的旁聽生。

en.t: After I left the high school dormitory, even when I went to school and sat in the classroom for lessons, I felt like a special sort of auditor.

units.source_text: 很有可能這是我的偏見，去了學校就興趣索然，也就更懶得去上學了。

en.t: Very likely this was only my own prejudice, but whenever I went to school I lost all interest, and I became even more reluctant to attend.

units.source_text: 從小學、中學、高中一路走過，最終還是無法理解何謂愛校之心，也從沒想過學唱校歌。

en.t: Having gone through elementary school, middle school, and high school, I still never understood what school spirit meant, and I never even thought of learning to sing the school song.

units.source_text: 不久，在繪畫教室，我從一位學畫畫的學生身上沾染了菸酒、嫖娼、當鋪和左翼思想。

en.t: Before long, at the painting class, I picked up alcohol, tobacco, prostitution, pawnshops, and leftist ideas from one of the art students.
